title: A MESSAGE FROM #JAMES THE GREATER
segments: as I sit here I waited my
faith the memories of my time with our
Lord Jesus Christ flood my mind how
could I have known that being a
fisherman by trade would lead me to such
a profound and life-altering
journey it was in those ordinary moments
when the sun was setting and we were
casting our Nets into the sea that he
called me to be his disciple from that
day forward my life was forever changed
I witnessed the Miracles the healings
and listened to the profound teachings
of the Son of God
himself alongside my brother John we
were entrusted with
responsibilities so great that it filled
me with both overwhelming joy and
crippling fear but I Master's love and
guidance were always present giving us
the strength and courage we need it now
as I find myself standing before this
court accused of my faith I am filled
with a peace that surpasses all
understanding the Roman officer who has
watched me throughout this trial stands
in awe he Witnesses the intensity of my
defense the unshakable belief in the one
who has given me
everything as we walk together towards
the place of execution the officer
overwhelmed by conviction confesses his
new found faith in Jesus Christ to the
judge never could I have imagined that
the words I spoke would have such a
profound impact on another person's life
he kneels beside me willingly accepting
beheading as a fellow follower of
Christ in this moment I am reminded of
the power of faith and the eternal
Legacy that can be left behind though my
physical life may come to an end my
purpose my impact will continue through
the lives that have been touched and
transformed by the gospel I'm grateful
for the privilege of sharing in the
sufferings of Christ and for the
opportunity to be an instrument of his
love and
grace
